test_case_name: Navigate from Privacy Policy to Cookies page and accept cookies

intents.intent: Click 'Cookies' link in the footer on the Privacy Policy page
Click 'Yes, I agree' button on the Cookies page
And then check that cookie preferences are accepted and the cookie popup is dismissed

test_case_name: Navigate from Privacy Policy to Cookies page and reject cookies

intents.intent: Click 'Cookies' link in the footer on the Privacy Policy page
Click 'No, thanks' button on the Cookies page
And then check that cookie preferences are rejected and the cookie popup is dismissed

test_case_name: Navigate from Privacy Policy to Cookies page and view cookie settings

intents.intent: Click 'Cookies' link in the footer on the Privacy Policy page
Click 'View cookie settings' button on the Cookies page
And then check that the cookie settings panel is displayed

test_case_name: Navigate from Privacy Policy to Cookies page and swipe carousel forward

intents.intent: Click 'Cookies' link in the footer on the Privacy Policy page
Click 'Swipe carousel forward' button on the Cookies page
And then check that the carousel advances to the next item

test_case_name: Navigate from Privacy Policy to Cookies page and select 'One way' trip type

intents.intent: Click 'Cookies' link in the footer on the Privacy Policy page
Click 'One way' button on the Cookies page
And then check that 'One way' trip type is selected

test_case_name: Navigate from Privacy Policy to Cookies page and select 'Return trip' trip type

intents.intent: Click 'Cookies' link in the footer on the Privacy Policy page
Click 'Return trip' button on the Cookies page
And then check that 'Return trip' trip type is selected

test_case_name: Navigate from Privacy Policy to Cookies page and search for flights

intents.intent: Click 'Cookies' link in the footer on the Privacy Policy page
Type $name into 'Departure' input on the Cookies page
Type $name into 'Destination' input on the Cookies page
Click 'Search' button on the Cookies page
And then check that the flight search results are displayed

test_case_name: Navigate from Privacy Policy to Cookies page and apply a promo code

intents.intent: Click 'Cookies' link in the footer on the Privacy Policy page
Click 'Apply promo code' button on the Cookies page
And then check that the promo code input or confirmation is displayed
